Name: Ammihud, Son of Laadan
Summary: Son of Laadan and father of Elishama in Ephraim's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:26: Son of Laadan and father of Elishama in Ephraim's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ammihud stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
